prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the mold from workbench and move it to tray.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether a clean mold is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A low-angle, slightly blurred view of a bench station. Top left: a white sign reading "Synthesis Workstation" with Chinese characters, bearing a purple-framed square fiducial (QR-like) marker. Behind it, two black vertical posts rise from the bench.

Right of centre: a black rack holding four clear tubes standing upright, each capped with an orange closure; the tubes appear empty. The rack sits on a grey extruded-aluminium frame with slotted profiles and a metal bracket.

Foreground: a brushed aluminium block with a white face carrying another black-and-white fiducial marker, plus several silver knurled bolt heads and fittings along its edges. Left foreground: white plastic plates and a white cylindrical post; another white cylindrical cap-like piece lies centre-right. Light background wall.
observations: The description of the workbench does not mention the presence of a mold; it only identifies a tube rack, tubes, and other workstation components.
